prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 when I was in Shanghai, I remember just wandering around and talking about all the big attractions people always mention there.
That same trip, we also chatted a lot about hotels in Shanghai—mostly just comparing neighborhoods and what felt convenient.
And earlier that spring, my coworker did that classic route from Beijing to Shanghai by train, which sounded way smoother than flying.
My cousin Emily Wang had already gotten tickets for the Oriental Pearl Tower for 2025-03-05, and she picked an afternoon time slot.
It was kind of a whole family thing—she put it under Emily Wang and it was for 5 people total.
A different time, my friend Lucas Martinez stayed at Hanting Hotel People's Square—he checked in on 2025-03-21 and only did 2 nights.
Oh, and Zhou Jun told me he’d taken train G1 on 2025-04-20, First Class—he said it was honestly pretty comfortable.
